# Express v5.3.0 release notes (draft)

This compares v5.3.0 with v5.2.1, which is the previous tag on the 5.x line. The most recent tag by date is v4.22.3, but that is a 4.x release. The range has 76 commits.

## Features
- Allow conditional revalidation for `QUERY` requests (#7366)
- Allow `null` or `undefined` as the `options` value in `app.render` (#6903)
- Don't modify `Content-Type` twice when sending strings (#6991)

## Bug fixes
- **res.send:** Preserve ETag generation when `Transfer-Encoding` is set (#7459)
- **res.send:** Add `Content-Length` only when `Transfer-Encoding` is absent (#4893)
- Replace deprecated `trimRight()` with `trimEnd()` (#7265)
- Improve `req.acceptsCharsets` (#6088)
- Fix the search example to support Redis v4+ and Express 4/5 (#6274)

## Security and dependencies
- Bump the `qs` minimum to 6.16.0 (#7478). Earlier bumps in this range were ^6.14.1, ^6.14.2 for CVE-2026-2391 (#7057), and 6.15.2.
- Bump `body-parser` to ^2.3.0 to fix CVE-2026-12590 (#7390)
- Upgrade `content-disposition` (#7233) and `content-type` (#7234)
- Require `proxy-addr@^2.0.8` (#7474)
- Dev dependencies: `hbs` 4.3.1 and `morgan` 1.12.1

## Other changes
- Log the full error object for better error logging (#6464)
- Polish the HTML structure of the `res.redirect()` response (#5167)

## Documentation
- Fix typos and a stale API reference in lib comments (#7512, #7509, #7483)
- Fix JSDoc for `req.accepts()` (#6936)
- Clean up deprecated `back` references in `res.location` (#7406)
- README fixes: new logo, npm docs URL, dead link, security policy link, and GitHub Discussions capitalization
- Triage team additions: @GroophyLifefor, @krzysdz, @rxmarbles

## Tests
- Add edge-case tests for `res.type()` (#7037)
- Add a test for the `normalizeType` fallback (#6894)
- Add unit tests for `utils.compileETag` (#6534)
- Remove duplicate tests in `res.location` and `res.jsonp` (#6996)

## Internal (CI, build, chores)
- Add npm staged publication with dist-tag support (#7464)
- Build with Node.js v26 in CI (#7218)
- Group GitHub Actions updates (#7460), plus about 25 Dependabot bumps to GitHub Actions
- Ensure safe config in `.npmrc` (#7144)
- Remove the `benchmarks` directory (#6992)

# Express 5.3.0 release notes (draft)

Changes since v5.2.1, drawn from `git log v5.2.1..v5.3.0`.

## Features
- **QUERY requests can now be revalidated.** `req.fresh` now covers QUERY as well as GET and HEAD, so a matching validator returns 304 (#7366).
- **`app.render` accepts `null` or `undefined` options.** It now behaves the same as omitting options or passing an empty object (#6903).
- **`res.send` no longer modifies Content-Type twice for strings** (#6991).
- **`res.redirect()` HTML body is better formed.** It now includes `<!DOCTYPE html>`, `<title>` and `<body>` (#5167).

## Bug fixes
- **`res.send` no longer sets `Content-Length` when `Transfer-Encoding` is present.** This avoids sending two headers that conflict under the HTTP spec (#4893).
- **ETag generation still works when `Transfer-Encoding` is set** (#7459).
- **`req.acceptsCharsets` was fixed** (#6088).
- **`trimRight()` was replaced with `trimEnd()`** (#7265).
- **Error logging now prints the full error object** (#6464).

## Security and dependencies
- **`qs` is now `^6.16.0`.** This addresses CVE-2026-2391 and the other `qs` advisories listed in `History.md` (CVE-2026-82417 and CVE-2026-82562). The bumps landed in #7057, #7305 and #7478.
- **`body-parser` is now `^2.3.0`.** This fixes CVE-2026-12590 (#7390).
- **`proxy-addr` is now `^2.0.8`.** This fixes CVE-2026-90711 (#7474).
- **`content-type` and `content-disposition` were upgraded** (#7234, #7233).

## Documentation
- The logo was updated (#7316).
- JSDoc for `req.accepts()` was fixed (#6936).
- Deprecated `back` references were removed from the `res.location` docs (#7406).
- The search example now supports Redis v4+ and Express 4/5 (#6274).
- Various typo, link and wording fixes: #7512, #7509, #7483, #7426, #7191, #7159, #7136, #7064, #7029.
- Triage team additions: @GroophyLifefor, @krzysdz and @rxmarbles.
- The security policy docs now point to the global policy.

## Internal, CI and tests
- CI now builds on Node.js 26 (#7218).
- npm staged publication with dist-tag support was added (#7464).
- Dependabot now groups GitHub Actions updates (#7460).
- The npmrc config was hardened (#7144).
- The `benchmarks` directory was removed (#6992).
- Tests were added or tidied: `res.type()` edge cases, `normalizeType` fallback, `compileETag`, and removal of duplicate `res.location` and `res.jsonp` tests.
- Routine dev-dependency and GitHub Actions bumps: `hbs`, `morgan`, `actions/*`, `codeql-action` and `coveralls`.

## Contributors
Thanks to @YuryShkoda, @cuishuang, @davetashner, @cyphercodes, @lazerg, @Cherry, @Bernice55231, @AkaHarshit, @blakeembrey, @Mayvis, and the other first-time and returning contributors.
